newsitem.title: USA: Crossmann files for share offering.
newsitem.headline: Crossmann files for share offering.

text.p: Crossmann Communities Inc said Monday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 2,250,000 shares.
The offering includes 1,500,000 shares to be sold by Crossmann and 750,000 to be sold by certain shareholders.
The shares have been adjusted for a previously announced three-for-two stock split payable August 25, it said.
The offering will be made through an underwriting group managed by McDonald & Co Securities Inc, Dillon, Read & Co Inc, and Raymond James & Associates Inc.
Crossmann is a builder of single-family homes in Indiana, Ohio and Kentucky.
